issues.on_page: Gothenburg Community Redevelopment Authority (A component Unit of the City of Gothenburg)
issues.issue: A CRA is a separate component unit, not the city itself; 'other' fits better.
Principal and interest are combined and the page doesn't split them. The whole amount is put in principal (the extractor marked it for review).
Calling TIF revenue property tax is a defensible judgment call, but it is one (marked for review).
